acceptanceCriteria: per-spec ocm-prepare time measured quiet and at load ~60, with the dominant stage named
the cost is reduced or the timeout is reported with the stopped spec/stage and a resume path; numbers retained
body: Observed by the guarding-tests lane (PR #961, 2026-10-16) at load 52-80: a 44-hunk, 3-intent-spec bind ran passes 1 and 1b; the cite step bound all 44 hunks, but each `ocm-prepare` took ~5 min per spec and one returned `verification-timeout`; both passes hit the 580 s limit and the bind could not complete. Related: V1-1151 (completed; large batch), V1-1322 (open; unmoved BASE). Expected: ocm-prepare cost per spec measured and bounded, and a timeout reported with the spec and stage it stopped in.

title: dogfood: ocm-prepare costs ~5 min per spec and returns verification-timeout under load, so a 3-spec bind exceeds a 600 s window
